name: @mcpforge/mocks
description: The offline mock/recorded-target harness (W0-H6). Versioned fixture recording + deterministic replay for 'a target' across test tiers, so unit/contract/policy tests run with no live Oracle instance and no network (02 §7.1, §7.3). `refresh:fixtures` is the opt-in, real-target leg — it is a no-op unless MCPFORGE_LIVE_TARGET_URL is set, matching W0-C5/W0-D3's Postgres/Keycloak gating convention.
